scrambled_tile_sets.hint: Responsible protection and management of resources/institutions.

editing_checkers.passage_text: In Chapter 7, key decisions are made by institutions.

hotspots.label: Primary Inputs: Land & Labour
hotspots.popover_description: Land includes all natural resources (soil, water, minerals); Labour includes human physical and mental effort.

hotspots.label: Physical Capital: Fixed vs Working Capital
hotspots.popover_description: Fixed capital lasts over years (machinery, factory buildings); Working capital is consumed in a single cycle (raw materials, cash).

hotspots.label: Entrepreneurship & Human Capital (Kaizen)
hotspots.popover_description: Entrepreneurs organize factors and bear risk; Human capital is developed through health, education (SWAYAM), and Kaizen continuous improvement.
